name: Info Vis Project
install:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.npm-global"
npm config set prefix "$HOME/.npm-global"
npm install -g firebase-tools

terminals.name: Firebase Hosting emulator
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH" && firebase emulators:start --only hosting --project demo-infoviz
terminals.description: Serves public/ at http://127.0.0.1:5000 to match Firebase Hosting.
